description: Fast, natural speech in 20 voices, with tags like [laugh], [sigh] or [chuckle] for expression. Up to 500 characters per call. Compared with other audio tools: budget, and one of the most used right now. Price: $0.034 per 1,000 characters (one call: $0.018 per clip (up to 500 characters)), charged only on success. With an account API key you pay only for what the call used (per 1,000 characters), never more than this price. One call = speech for up to 500 characters.
